'''Valor's Rest''' is the name of an outpost in [[Silithus]] used by both the [[Alliance]] and the [[Horde]]. The most notable feature is its [[graveyard]]. It is home to members of the [[Cenarion Circle]] and a vaguely familiar insect infestation. '''Valor's Rest''' can be reached easily by riding up the path in the northwest corner of the [[Un'Goro Crater]], and it is the first thing you will see when entering [[Silithus]].

Prior to [[patch 1.8]], it contained the single [[flight path]] on the whole of Silithus. This was moved to [[Cenarion Hold]], on its establishment.
